        required: false
        type: string

        required: false

        description: Pull request title
        required: false

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

# One run at a time per release branch; back promotes, one at a time per back-promote branch; rollbacks, one at

concurrency:
  group: release-relay-${{ ((github.event_name == 'schedule' && github.event.schedule == '17 * * * *') || inputs.mode == 'slack') && 'slack-due' || github.event_name == 'schedule' && 'archive' || ((inputs.mode == 'compare' || inputs.mode == 'drift' || inputs.mode == 'routediff' || inputs.mode == 'data') && format('{0}-{1}', inputs.mode, inputs.request_id) || (inputs.mode == 'rollback' && format('rollback-{0}', inputs.target_environment) || (inputs.mode == 'sync' && inputs.target || inputs.branch))) }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  RELAY_PROVIDER: github
  REQUEST_ID: ${{ inputs.request_id }}

  ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.environment }}

  BRANCH: ${{ inputs.branch }}
  TARGET: ${{ inputs.target }}
  TITLE: ${{ inputs.title }}

    if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'org' || inputs.mode == 'branch' || inputs.mode == 'promote' || inputs.mode == 'hub' || inputs.mode == 'resolve' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: ${{ inputs.environment }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      # Optional: a GitHub App token, so the new pull request triggers your own PR checks.
      - name: Create GitHub App token
        id: app
        if: ${{ vars.RELAY_APP_ID != '' }}
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@v1
        with:
          app
conflicts.theirs:
# Release Relay pipeline files: version 24
# Version 24: Slack reminders and the daily digest. A second schedule (every hour at :17, "17 * * * *") runs the
# slack-due job only: it signs in to the hub like the archive job and calls POST /services/apexrest/rly/slack-due once
# per pass until the hub says done (at most 10 calls). The hub decides what is due per org (reminders, digests); an
# org with them off is never read. Repository variable RELAY_SLACK_DUE=off skips the job; mode "slack" runs it by hand.
# The hourly runs aren't posted to the Pipeline Monitor. The nightly archive (0 8 * * *) is unchanged.
# Also version 24: data sets (the hub's Sync status tab, Data; request ids DAT-<13 digits>). Mode "data": the data-export job
# signs in to the source org (inputs.environment; skipped when the hub already sent a developer org's records to
# release-relay-results under data-inbox/<id>/) and saves its records there; the data-load job signs in to the target
# (inputs.target_environment), matches records by each object's match key, masks and swaps per-org values, and either
# dry-runs (options.dryRun: counts only, nothing changes) or loads parents first, then children. results/<id>/data.json
# for the hub. The Pipeline Monitor shows "Data".
# Version 23: the hub's Sync status tab (request ids SYN-<13 digits>). Mode "drift" (Org vs branch): the drift job runs
# in the org's own environment (inputs.environment), signs in like validate and deploy, reads the whole org (managed
# packages left out) and compares it with its branch (target); results/<id>/drift.json for the hub. Mode "routediff"
# (Down the route): Git only, no environment: what each higher branch in options.route has that the next one down
# doesn't; results/<id>/route.json. Mode "compare" with options.full: a developer org read whole by the hub, same
# drift.json. Mode "sync" with options.paths: back promote only the picked files (a file the lower branch changed too
# is a conflict, never overwritten); with branch = target, Push to the org: just the picked components are deployed
# from the branch. Mode "sync" with options.branchOnly and no target environment (a developer org): the sync-branch job
# (no environment) only updates the lower branch. The Pipeline Monitor shows "Org vs branch" and "Down the route".
# Version 22: mode "compare" (the hub's Compare before raising, for big releases). The hub commits the developer org's
# copy as Metadata API zips to release-relay-results (compare-inbox/<id>/<n>.zip) and starts the run with request_id
# CMP-<13 digits>, target = the branch to compare with, components/deletions and options.batches. The compare job signs
# in to no org and uses no environment: it converts the zips on top of the target branch and writes
# results/<id>/compare.json and results/<id>/f/<n>.json for the hub to read. Every other job skips; the Pipeline Monitor
# shows the run as "Compare". Also in version 22: the hub can send a big release in parts
# (.relay-inbox/<REL>-part-<k>.zip on the release branch); the script unpacks them all.
# Version 21: the archive call sends its JSON body inline (--body "$body"). "sf api request rest --body" sent the file's
# path as the body, so the hub never saw the body.
# Version 20: Pipeline Monitor. Two small jobs tell the hub about every run, signed in with the hub environment's login
# (vars.RELAY_HUB_ENVIRONMENT, default prod) like the archive job, through "sf api request rest": monitor-start posts
# "In progress" when the run starts, monitor-end (always, after every other job) posts how it ended (Succeeded, Failed
# or Cancelled), when, how long, the jobs' outcomes and the first failure (read with this run's token: actions, checks).
# The hub shows them on its Pipeline Monitor tab and keeps them for its Retention days. They never fail the run: a
# failed call is a warning. Set the repository variable RELAY_MONITOR to off to skip both (for example when the hub
# environment needs a reviewer). The nightly archive's log also says how many old monitor runs the hub removed.
# Version 19: the archive job calls the hub with "sf api request rest" (newer Salesforce CLIs hide the access token in
# "sf org display", so the old curl call was sent without a sign-in and got INVALID_AUTH_HEADER).
# Version 18: the nightly archive can also be started by hand: Actions → Release Relay → Run workflow → mode "archive"
# (the other fields can stay blank); same job as the 2:00 AM schedule.
# Version 17: a release whose Apex is only deletions and inactive triggers (status Inactive in the trigger's -meta.xml)
# and that names no tests runs the local tests (RunLocalTests) in production, as Salesforce requires, and no tests
# (NoTestRun) in sandboxes; "production" comes from the hub (options.production: the target is the hub org). The tests
# and coverage gates leave inactive triggers out (no 0% failure for them).
# Version 16: a file that is new on one side only no longer counts as a conflict when git pairs it with a file the
# other side deleted (identical -meta.xml files looked like a rename); the release branch's file is kept.
# Version 15: a nightly schedule (on.schedule, 08:00 UTC = 2:00 AM Central in winter) runs the archive job: it signs in
# to the hub and calls POST /services/apexrest/rly/archive once per pass (at most 25) until the hub says done. The hub
# removes finished releases older than its Retention days only when "Archive every night" is on; every other job skips
# on the schedule. Hub environment: vars.RELAY_HUB_ENVIRONMENT (default prod).
# Version 14: a promotion can take each changed file as it is in the previous stage (options.stageBranch) and stops on
# a hotfix the stage doesn't have (raise.json "clash"); changes can be added to an open release (mode hub with
# options.append and options.appendZip; raise.json "appended").
# Version 13: per-org values (.relay/values.json: {{relay:NAME}} placeholders filled per target org at deploy time,
# turned back into placeholders when org metadata is written to a branch), quality gates (.relay/gates.json: scan
# priority, Apex coverage, tests required for Apex), rollback snapshots before every deploy (release-relay-snapshots
# branch) and mode=rollback, and a cached Salesforce CLI.
# Release Relay's own metadata (its components by exact name, plus .relay/exclude) is never validated, deployed or deleted;
# options {"selfUpdate":true} (the hub updating itself, from the release-relay-hub branch) ignores the list.
# Release Relay: started from Salesforce (workflow_dispatch), and every night by the schedule (archive job only).
#   archive      (schedule only) ask the hub to archive finished releases older than its Retention days, one
#                pass per call, logging each pass; the hub skips when "Archive every night" is off.
#   mode=org     retrieve the selected components from the source org, apply deletions, commit to a
#                new branch, open a pull request into the target branch, then scan and validate it.
#   mode=branch  open a pull request from a branch that already exists, then scan and validate it.
#   mode=promote make a promote/ branch from the target with each file the merge commits listed in
#                components changed, as it is in options.stageBranch (the previous stage; without it the
#                commits are cherry-picked), open a pull request, then scan and validate it.
#   mode=hub     the Release Relay hub committed its retrieve (a Metadata API zip) to the branch:
#                convert it to source format (none for a release with only deletions,
#                a .relay-inbox/<id>.deletions marker instead), remove the deleted components' files,
#                open a pull request into the target, scan and validate.
#                options {"append":true,"appendZip":".relay-inbox/<id>-add-<k>.zip"}: add that zip's changes to the
#                open release's branch (no new pull request), then scan and validate again.
#   mode=resolve merge the target into the branch with the conflict choices the hub committed, then
#                scan and validate again.
#   mode=check   scan and validate an open pull request again (after a fix, or on request).
#   mode=merge   merge the pull request approved in Salesforce, then deploy it to the target org,
#                then merge the target into the branches in options.syncBranches (each one directly).
#   mode=sync    back promote: merge branch (the hub's production branch) into target (a back-promote
#                org's branch, made from branch when missing), deploy what changed to the org in
#                target_environment, and push target only when that deploy worked (results/<id>/sync.json).
#   mode=rollback deploy a snapshot taken before an earlier deploy back into the org in target_environment
#                (options.snapshotPath, else the latest for the release and environment); branch, target and title
#                aren't used (send the target org's branch and a short title). Writes results/<id>/rollback.json.
# Validation and deployment run only when Salesforce passes a target environment (the GitHub
# environment that holds the target org's login). Each step writes its result as JSON to the
# release-relay-results branch, where Salesforce reads it.
# options (JSON, from Salesforce): {"scan":"off"} skips the code scan; {"hub":true} skips the
# ALLOWED_TARGETS check (the hub enforces its route); {"tests":[...]} sets the test classes
# (RunSpecifiedTests, or NoTestRun when empty); {"validateMerged":true} validates the branch merged
# with the target; {"attempt":"..."} is the hub's run token, echoed in every result;
# {"syncBranches":[...]} and {"stageWins":true} are for merge; {"notify":"dev"} makes the
# last job tell that org (signing in with that environment's login) to read the results at once;
# {"snapshot":false} skips the rollback snapshot before a deploy; {"snapshotPath":"REL-00042/prod/<id>"} picks
# the snapshot for mode=rollback.
name: Release Relay
run-name: "${{ ((github.event_name == 'schedule' && github.event.schedule == '17 * * * *') || inputs.mode == 'slack') && 'Release Relay Slack reminders' || ((github.event_name == 'schedule' || inputs.mode == 'archive') && 'Release Relay nightly archive' || format('Release Relay {0} ({1})', inputs.request_id, inputs.mode)) }}"

on:
  # Nightly archive. Cron is UTC: 0 8 * * * is 2:00 AM Central in winter (CST), 3:00 AM in summer (CDT); change the
  # hour to your quiet time. GitHub may start it a few minutes late.
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 8 * * *"
    # Slack reminders and daily digests (version 24): every hour at :17; the hub sends only what is due.
    - cron: "17 * * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      request_id:
        description: Salesforce release number (blank for archive)
        required: false
        type: string
      mode:
        description: org, branch, promote, hub, resolve, check, merge, sync, rollback, compare, drift, routediff, data (from the hub), archive (the nightly archive, by hand) or slack (Slack reminders and digests, by hand)
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [org, branch, promote, hub, resolve, check, merge, sync, rollback, compare, drift, routediff, data, archive, slack]
      environment:
        description: GitHub environment of the source org (sync = the hub's production org)
        required: false
        type: string
      target_environment:
        description: GitHub environment of the target org (blank = Git only, no validate or deploy)
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      branch:
        description: Source branch (sync = the hub's production branch)
        required: false
        type: string
      target:
        description: Target branch (sync = the back-promote org's branch)
        required: false
        type: string
      title:
        description: Pull request title
        required: false
        type: string
      components:
        description: Type:Name list to retrieve, comma separated (promote = the releases' merge commits)
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      deletions:
        description: Type:Name list to delete, comma separated
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      options:
        description: 'JSON options from Salesforce, for example {"scan":"off","notify":"dev"}'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: '{}'

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

# One run at a time per release branch; back promotes, one at a time per back-promote branch; rollbacks, one at
# a time per org; the nightly archive, one at a time; each compare on its own.
concurrency:
  group: release-relay-${{ ((github.event_name == 'schedule' && github.event.schedule == '17 * * * *') || inputs.mode == 'slack') && 'slack-due' || github.event_name == 'schedule' && 'archive' || ((inputs.mode == 'compare' || inputs.mode == 'drift' || inputs.mode == 'routediff' || inputs.mode == 'data') && format('{0}-{1}', inputs.mode, inputs.request_id) || (inputs.mode == 'rollback' && format('rollback-{0}', inputs.target_environment) || (inputs.mode == 'sync' && inputs.target || inputs.branch))) }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  RELAY_PROVIDER: github
  REQUEST_ID: ${{ inputs.request_id }}
  MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
  ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.environment }}
  TARGET_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.target_environment }}
  BRANCH: ${{ inputs.branch }}
  TARGET: ${{ inputs.target }}
  TITLE: ${{ inputs.title }}

jobs:
  raise:
    if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'org' || inputs.mode == 'branch' || inputs.mode == 'promote' || inputs.mode == 'hub' || inputs.mode == 'resolve' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: ${{ inputs.environment }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      # Optional: a GitHub App token, so the new pull request triggers your own PR checks.
      - name: Create GitHub App token
        id: app
        if: ${{ vars.RELAY_APP_ID != '' }}
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@v1
        with:
          app-id: ${{ vars.RELAY_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELAY_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token || github.token }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      # The Salesforce CLI (major version 2) is cached per runner OS and month, so most runs skip the install.
      - name: Salesforce CLI cache key
        id: sfkey
        if: ${{ (inputs.mode == 'org' && inputs.components != '') || inputs.mode == 'hub' }}
        run: echo "key=relay-sf-cli2-${RUNNER_OS}-node22-$(date -u +%Y-%m)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Cache Salesforce CLI
        if: ${{ (inputs.mode == 'org' && inputs.components != '') || inputs.mode == 'hub' }}
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.relay-sf
          key: ${{ steps.sfkey.outputs.
